**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed)

The Agreement contains no take-or-pay exposure for Sparkling:

- **Section 11 (p0084)** — fees are simply those set out in the Fee Schedule, with no committed minimum volume or spend.
- **Section 2 (p0028)** — additional fees arise only if Sparkling elects to use the Software outside the Authorized Locations, i.e. usage-based.
- **Section 10 (p0065)** — maintenance runs on a "renewable one-year term," not a multi-year committed maintenance tail.
- **Section 17(b) (p0118)** — Sparkling has an unconditional termination right on ninety (90) days' notice, so no spend is locked in.

Targeted searches for "minimum", "commit", "take or pay", "shortfall", "volume", "quantity" and "non-refundable" surfaced nothing imposing a purchase commitment or usage cap on us. This sits at the **preferred** position, so no edit is required.
